title: 英伟达芯片流入中国 美中AI监管再添变数
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Bloomberg has learned that a Chinese company founded by Alice Wang, who is at the center of Invidia's controversy, procured smuggled AI chips that were installed at a Shanghai
segments.zh: 彭博获悉，处于英伟达争议中心的Alice Wang创办的一家中国公司，采购了走私AI芯片，并安装在上海一个

segments.en: data center with links to Megaspeed International. Now, the documents offer the most explicit evidence yet that an expansive network of Chinese
segments.zh: 与Megaspeed International有关联的数据中心。这些文件提供了迄今最明确的证据，表明一个庞大的中国

segments.en: companies managed to get its hands on smuggled Invidia hardware.
segments.zh: 企业网络设法获得了走私的英伟达硬件。

segments.en: We're joining us now as Parmi Olsen, Bloomberg opinion columnist covering technology and Azimazar Founder of Exponential Views, so thank you both for joining us.
segments.zh: 现在加入我们的是彭博观点专栏作家、科技领域撰稿人Parmi Olsen，以及Exponential Views创始人Azimazar，感谢二位参与。

segments.en: Parmi, I just want to start with you because it's now taking on much more of a concerning nature of the relationship between the US and China.
segments.zh: Parmi，我想先从你开始，因为现在美中关系正呈现出更令人担忧的性质。

segments.en: Do you think this is where the story is going next? Yeah, I mean, I think this is great.
segments.zh: 你认为这就是故事接下来的走向吗？是的，我认为这很好。

segments.en: What's happened to Jensen Huang is great for the so-called China Hawks, anyone that is against the idea of flooding the Chinese market with powerful AI chips, which is something that Huang
segments.zh: 黄仁勋的遭遇对所谓的对华鹰派来说很好，任何反对向中国市场大量输入强大AI芯片的人都是如此，而黄仁勋

segments.en: had argued for for a long time. His view was, let's make Chinese companies dependent on American technology, and that's kind of the road to supremacy for them, but not everybody agrees with that in the White
segments.zh: 长期以来一直主张这一点。他的观点是，让中国公司依赖美国技术，这对他们来说是通往主导地位的道路，但白宫

segments.en: House. So I think anybody who is kind of pushing for that has lost a very important advocate.
segments.zh: 并非所有人都同意。所以我认为任何推动这一点的人都失去了一位非常重要的倡导者。

segments.en: China also doesn't want to bring in lower-powered chips into the country.
segments.zh: 中国也不想将低性能芯片引入国内。
